output_list.criticism: This is the constructor function which deploys the token. In case, initial supply is too large (eg. more than 1e21), this could lead to an overload in the token. It also assigns the token name and symbol immediately to the constructor. These two properties could be misused by the attacker by changing the initial supply and token name. In future, the initial supply and token name should be passed as parameters in a function instead of setting it as constant. The attacker can then exploit this vulnerability to mint more tokens. Hence, it is highly profitable to fix this vulnerability.
